decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment of the session SDK Dynamic Workflows doc. It still says the API is experimental. It adds eligibility limits, soft AI-credit budgets and storage requirements. No human date or gate is renewed.

citations.quote: Dynamic Workflows are extension-authored, session-scoped workflows that coordinate subagents and durable steps. The API is experimental.
still require eligible credentials (token-based billing or trusted HMAC authentication).
This is a soft, post-paid ceiling, so completed or parallel turns can settle above it before the run stops.
SDK-initiated run and resume do not request permission, so they have no declined outcome.

findings.reason: Doc says the API is experimental and limits execution to token-based billing or trusted HMAC credentials. Tenant eligibility and a pilot cohort are not evidenced.
findings.next: Confirm the stage, supported clients and account eligibility with a pilot identity.

findings.reason: The doc names no organization or enterprise policy to disable or scope Dynamic Workflows.
findings.next: Find an official admin control, or record that none exists.

findings.reason: Credential eligibility is described, but how runs map to user identity and least privilege is not.
findings.next: Verify identity and permission handling for runs in a pilot.

findings.reason: Runs journal results in durable storage. Retention, residency and prompt data handling are not documented here.
findings.next: Review official data handling and storage documentation.

findings.reason: SDK-initiated run and resume request no permission, so no human approval prompt applies on that path.
findings.next: Design an external approval checkpoint before any pilot.

findings.reason: Run observation APIs exist, but enterprise audit-log coverage is not documented here.
findings.next: Check whether runs appear in audit or export logs.

findings.reason: maxAiCredits is a soft, post-paid ceiling and may be exceeded. Real cost is unmeasured.
findings.next: Measure credits in a pilot and set a billing budget.

findings.reason: Network and endpoint requirements are not stated in this document.
findings.next: Document required endpoints and proxy behavior.

findings.reason: Resume, pause, cancel and storage-failure behavior is documented, but operational ownership and support are not.
findings.next: Assign an owner and test failure and resume handling.

findings.reason: No documented way to disable the feature tenant-wide or revert a run's side effects.
findings.next: Define a stop procedure and an idempotency plan for side effects.
